steps.content:
June 16, N.F. 115
The World Dome (also known as the Cristallia)
Opening Ceremony of the Great Expo

steps.speaker: Newscast
steps.content: Ladies and gentlemen from DisCity, Fraser, and all our partner city-states, and every viewer and listener tuning in from wherever you may be... welcome to the 13th Great Expo!

steps.speaker: Newscast
steps.content: Do you see the banners waving on every street? Do you hear the thunderous crowd? Do you like the breathtaking Cristallia, our crown jewel of this Expo?!

steps.speaker: Newscast
steps.content: And do you recognize the structure sitting just across the street from our spectacular exhibition hall?
[Sudden silence, followed by a wind sound effect]

steps.speaker: Newscast
steps.content: It's Keylan Square, the iconic landmark of DisCity's historic West District!

steps.speaker: Newscast
steps.content: That's right! Back in N.F. 33, DisCity erected the Keylan Square, a monument to one of humanity's most revered figures. Just one year later, history was made when it hosted the first Great Expo, marking the rise of the Hypercube industry. And from that moment, a tradition was born: every four years, regardless of distance, we return here, to explore our path forward together!

steps.speaker: Newscast
steps.content: Through calamities, poverty, and even war, we have kept this tradition alive. Yes, the N.F. 106 Expo ended in disappointment, but today marks a brand-new chapter! Communications have been restored, barriers fallen, and now we stand reunited at this hallowed ground, more determined than ever!

steps.speaker: Newscast
steps.content: Nine long years, my friends! During these years apart, here on this very square, DisCity successfully suppressed the Black Ring for the first time, restored order to Syndicate, witnessed the rise of the new mine, and watched humanity turn the tide against Mania, evolving from fearful retreat to defiant resistance... to ultimate conquest!

steps.speaker: Newscast
steps.content: This grand gathering reflects the rebirth of the West District, the revival of DisCity, and above all, the renaissance of humanity itself! We come together celebrating peace, progress, and civilization, but beyond all these fancy words, what really matters is...

steps.speaker: Newscast
steps.content: <color=#fb9259>WEALTH!</color> That's right—cold, hard <color=#fb9259><size=52>WEALTH!!!</color></size> <color=#fb9259><size=60>OPPORTUNITY AND WEALTH</color></size> that everyone truly wants!!!

steps.speaker: Newscast
steps.content: The new mine is about to go operational! Cutting-edge extraction methods are changing the game!! Hypercube reserves, stagnant for years, are poised to skyrocket. The world now stands ready to welcome a new era of economic prosperity!
[Stock market chart screenshot from PV]

steps.speaker: Newscast
steps.content: The Eastside Stock Exchange is leading this historic rally! Look at those numbers climb! Nirvana! Quinn!! And UniversalTech! This is a full-market explosion with institutional whales and retail investors all charging in together!
[Scene Change: Another Exhibition Hall]

steps.speaker: Newscast
steps.content: Now feast your eyes on the wonders inside the Cristallia! Exotic fruits! Glittering rare minerals! Treasures beyond price! These regional marvels long obscured by calamities will finally enter the public eye, with all top livestreamers poised to bring them straight to your screens!

steps.speaker: Newscast
steps.content: Resources represent VALUE! Trade generates WEALTH! Am I right or am I right? Now, let's turn our cameras to the Outland representative, the visionary who made this Great Expo possible—

steps.speaker: Newscast
steps.content: Our distinguished guest from Fraser City, Mr. <color=#fb9259>Adelaide Campbell</color>!
[Camera Shake, Adelaide's Portrait] 1s

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: You're most kind, but I'm not really an official representative, merely an advisor accompanying our city-state delegation.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: Greetings, I am <color=#fb9259>Adelaide Campbell</color>. Having now set foot on this great land, I must say DisCity's prosperity exceeds all my expectations, truly deserving its reputation as humanity's beacon.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: Calamities have constricted humanity's living space, breeding widespread anxiety. We've endured our share of friction—misunderstandings, mutual suspicion, even isolation and harm. Yet ahead lie new possibilities: shipping routes to connect us, treaties to bind us, and investments to uplift us all.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: For these ten days, may we lay aside our differences and divisions, devoting ourselves wholly to progress and shared prosperity. Let us move beyond what was, and focus instead on what may yet be. I look forward to seeing a world reconnected, where love and equality find their rightful place once more.

steps.speaker: Newscast
steps.content: Well said!! Go on, we're all with you!

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: That concludes my remarks. Now, might I suggest you return the camera to our capable reporter and resume your duty...

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: ...Mr. <color=#fb9259>Max King</color>, our new Speaker of DisCity? And Speaker, if I may, the opening ceremony does await its host, does it not?

steps.speaker: Newscast
steps.content: Oh come now! I was just adding some spark to the occasion! When else do we get moments like this? Rules were made to be bent, and everyone deserves a happy little surprise!
[Camera shakes as Max King's portrait enters the frame. Maybe there's time to add a zoom effect?]

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: Ahem! Let's start over.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: Ladies and gentlemen, DisCitizens and distinguished guests from city-states far and wide, welcome to the opening ceremony of the Great Expo!

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: This grand gathering will chronicle the West District's rebirth, DisCity's resurgence, and humanity's hard-won renaissance against calamities. Here we stand reunited, to witness together peace, progress, and civilization.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: With great honor, I declare the 13th Great Expo officially opened! Let us all bear witness to history in the making!
